mapper.select: /* com.portal.security.authority.AuthorRoleManageMapper.selectAuthorRoleList */ SELECT a.ROLE_CODE AS roleCode, a.ROLE_NM AS roleNm, a.ROLE_PTTRN AS rolePtn, a.ROLE_DC AS roleDc, a.ROLE_TY AS roleTyp, a.ROLE_SORT AS roleSort, b.AUTHOR_CODE AS authorCode, DATE_FORMAT(b.CREAT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS creatDt, (CASE WHEN b.ROLE_CODE IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS regYn FROM LETTNROLEINFO a LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT AUTHOR_CODE, ROLE_CODE, CREAT_DT FROM LETTNAUTHORROLERELATE WHERE AUTHOR_CODE = #{searchKeyword} ) b ON a.ROLE_CODE = b.ROLE_CODE LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
